name: Crate of Lightforge Ingots
summary: In Duskwood, the Crate of Lightforge Ingots carries hope against Morbent Fel. The rare consecrated metal is bound for the Dwarven District in Stormwind.

sections.title: A Sacred Delivery
sections.body: Duskwood's hope rests in this crate of lightforge iron. The rare metal can channel holy power against dark entities, while Morbent Fel's protections turn aside ordinary steel. Only an artisan who knows its temper and honors its sacred nature can work it.

sections.title: The Weaponsmith of Stormwind
sections.body: Grimand Elmore is to receive the crate in Stormwind's Dwarven District. The skilled dwarven weaponsmith has not worked with lightforge iron in years, but agrees to forge it into a sanctified weapon. Its power is meant to break Morbent Fel's defenses and strike him down.

faq.answer: The crate holds consecrated lightforge iron, gathered for a weapon meant to pierce the necromancer Morbent Fel's magical defenses.

faq.q: Who is supposed to receive this crate?
aliases: who do i bring the crate to
faq.answer: The crate is meant for Grimand Elmore, a skilled dwarven weaponsmith in Stormwind's Dwarven District.
Morbent Fel's protections turn aside ordinary steel. Lightforge iron can channel holy power against dark entities.
Glorin Steelbrow packed the lightforge iron you recovered into the crate for delivery to Grimand Elmore in Stormwind.

angles.text: Working lightforge iron is a rare art. Even Grimand Elmore can go years without handling the sacred metal.
These ingots answer the Holy Light, making weapons forged from them a natural bane to necromancers and their undead minions.
